info.name: Get total global COVID-19 vaccine doses administered. Sourced from https://covid.ourworldindata.org/

params.name: lastdays
params.description: Number of days to return. Use 'all' for the full data set (e.g. 15, all, 24)

params.name: fullData
params.description: Flag indicating whether to return data type as simpleVaccineTimeline (false) or fullVaccineTimeline (true).
